arguments.message: Hi! All of your past invoices are stored in your workspace’s billing history. To view them, go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. The table there lists every invoice (most recent at the top), and each row links to a downloadable PDF. If a month is missing, it likely means no paid invoice was generated for that period (e.g., it was fully covered by a credit).
